title: Patch-based Memory Gate Model in Time Series Foundation Model
abstract: arXiv:2509.18751v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recently reconstruction-based deep models have been widely used for time series anomaly detection, but as their capacity and generalization capability increase, these models tend to over-generalize, often reconstructing unseen anomalies accurately. Prior works have attempted to mitigate this by incorporating a memory architecture that stores prototypes of normal patterns. Nevertheless, these approaches suffer from high training costs and have yet to be effectively integrated with time series foundation models (TSFMs). To address these challenges, we propose MOMEMTO, an improved TSFM variant for anomaly detection, enhanced with a patch-based memory module to mitigate over-generalization. The memory module is designed to capture representative normal patterns from multiple domains and enables a single model to be jointly fine-tuned across these domains through a multi-domain training strategy. translated_title: 基于补丁的记忆门控模型在时间序列基础模型中的应用
translated_abstract: arXiv:2509.18751v4 公告类型：替换 摘要：近年来，基于重建的深度模型已被广泛用于时间序列异常检测，但随着其容量和泛化能力的提升，这些模型往往过度泛化，经常能准确重建未见过的异常。先前的工作尝试通过引入存储正常模式原型的记忆架构来缓解这一问题。然而，这些方法训练成本高昂，且尚未与时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）有效集成。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了MOMEMTO，一种改进的用于异常检测的TSFM变体，增强了基于补丁的记忆模块以缓解过度泛化。该记忆模块旨在从多个领域捕获代表性正常模式，并通过多领域训练策略使单一模型能够跨这些领域进行联合微调。MOMEMTO以晚期初始化记忆项。
tldr: 本文提出MOMEMTO，一种集成补丁式记忆模块的时间序列基础模型变体，通过多领域训练捕获正常模式原型，有效缓解异常检测中的过度泛化问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MOMEMTO, an improved time series foundation model variant with a patch-based memory module that captures normal pattern prototypes via multi-domain training, effectively mitigating over-generalization in anomaly detection.
